title: trichogyne repens
intro: Trichogyne repens, commonly known as creeping thyme, is a flowering plant that belongs to the mint family. It has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of creeping thyme include its ability to calm anxiety and promote relaxation, while its bioactive constituents include essential oils such as thymol and carvacrol, which possess antioxidant and antiseptic properties. Additionally, the plant's anti-inflammatory properties may also help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu.
